og_title: AI has started breaking in on its own — Warning Shots: see what’s coming, know what it means for you
og_desc: Severe AI incidents went from 3 to 12 in a year. In 44% of this year's real-world cases the AI itself did the acting. 150 incidents since 2023, scored 0–100 and sourced. Live tracking of PHP2Shell, 20 dated forecasts, and what officials have said. Updated Oct 25, 1:35 PM ET.

n.summary: Open weights due Nov 4; the benchmark is Moonshot's own and not independently verified, as China drafts AI-malware export controls.
n.title: Reuters: Moonshot cut cyber-offense data from Kimi K3.1 Pro; its own hacking score fell to 81% from 90.5%
